A negative coefficient for every n >= 8 in the Alexandersson-Kebede cycle-restricted signed sum: a refutation of Conjecture 5.2.1 (Australas. J. Combin. 86(3) (2023))

Myeongjin Kang

Abstract

Conjecture 5.2.1 fails at k = 3 for every n >= 8 (ordinary proof; Lean certifies n = 9 for both the version-of-record and the MathDB/arXiv v3 wording); it holds for all 2 <= k <= n when n <= 7 (computation)

AI-assisted research preprint. The scoped main statement has a Lean certificate. Internal AI review is not external journal peer review; bounded prior-art searches do not certify worldwide priority. See the paper for exact qualifications and formalization limits.
